name: HextaUI
summary: React components, hooks and AI blocks for shadcn/ui, built on Base UI with the hard states handled.
description: Component library for shadcn/ui built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS v4: 65 free MIT components, 9 hooks and 5 utilities added with the shadcn CLI. Paid Pro blocks cover AI product screens (chat thread, streaming, tool calls, thinking, voice mode) plus the settings and account screens around them.
contains: 65 free MIT components, 9 hooks and 5 utilities
installed with the shadcn CLI from the @hextaui registry (139 registry items)
22 Pro blocks for AI products: chat thread, streaming, tool calls, thinking, voice mode, code block with diffs
free tier includes the Prompt Input block
Pro is a one-time $49 solo / $149 team of 10
MCP server at hextaui.com/mcp plus llms.txt and Markdown docs
React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 on shadcn/ui
